title: The Periodic Table and Its Groups

flashcard_questions.q: A table of all known elements arranged in order of increasing atomic number, with elements that have similar properties placed in the same vertical column (group).
The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom — this defines which element it is and determines its position in the periodic table.
A vertical column in the periodic table — elements in the same group have the same number of electrons in their outer shell and therefore similar chemical properties.
What did scientists first use to order the elements in the early 1800s?
Who left gaps in his periodic table for elements not yet discovered?
